candidate.answerReason: Equal consecutive differences give \(b-a=c-b\), which is reversibly equivalent to \(2b=a+c\). Hence D is correct.

methods.label: Recognize the arithmetic-middle identity
methods.explanation: 2 times the middle term equals the sum of the 2 outer terms. \(b^2=ac\) is the relation for a geometric mean.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing and distinguishing the arithmetic-mean and geometric-mean identities fits the supplied elective sequence scope.
